messages.subject: novice help!
parts:
Hello!

I am a novice R user and am trying to practice brainGraph before potentially using it to analyze my MRI data. however, I am finding it difficult to find sample datasets and scripts that I can follow to get the hang of brainGraph. Can anyone point me in the right direction? I do see the tutorials on the User Guide, but I can't seem to find the dataset that accompanies the tutorials... 

Best,
SaraBeth

messages.author: dadcb4fd6a01f8d1
messages.subject: Re: [brainGraph-help] novice help!
parts:
Hi, the datasets in the User Guide are not open datasets (and I don't "own" the data), which is why they are not shared. You can try some of the datasets here: http://umcd.humanconnectomeproject.org/
Otherwise, you could try using your own data and ask for help if you run into issues.

Chris
